INSERT INTO AC_DATA (CO_CODE, LC_CODE, CO_YEAR, CO_BOOK, VCH_TYPE, VCH_NO, VCH_DATE, LEDR_KEY, BOOK_NAME, BILL_NO, BILL_DATE, CHQ_NO, AC_CODE, LD_CODE, CR_AMT, DR_AMT, IT_TYPE, SIGN, FINE_WT, IT_DESC, ENTRY_TIME, HD_VCH_NO, CLR_DATE, DATA_TYPE, DATA_TRFR, MAIN_USER, FINE_RATE, PARTY_AC_CODE, LDR_NAME) Select A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,B.BOOK_SNAME,A.VCH_NO,A.VCH_DATE,A.CO_CODE+A.LC_CODE+A.CO_YEAR+A.CO_BOOK+A.VCH_NO+'11'+STR(A.SR_NO),B.MAIN_BOOK,'',Null,'',D.SALE_AC,A.AC_CODE,0,0,C.IT_TYPE,'+',A.ITM_FINE,'',A.VCH_TIME,A.HD_VCH_NO,Null,B.DATA_TYPE,'N',A.MAIN_USER,0,'','' FROM ((KR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.GR_CODE = D.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.MAIN_BOOK IN ('KARIGAR ISSUE','MTL ISU') AND B.BOOK_INOUT = 'O' ? AND A.CO_BOOK =' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_NO =' ? ' ? AND A.ITM_FINE <> 0
